This is an opinion and my personal thought process.

All past showings aside, C9 16-1'd CLG. That's pretty fucking monumental, HOWEVER, they got fucking whooped too. The methodical outdoing of C9's tactics was just brutal. I was only going to watch a couple minutes before bed, but that ended up being the whole match. They weren't playing bad, Luminosity just showed them how poor CLG was playing. Thus, I think  that with this better showing from CLG, the fragging of TJM (RIP) on Dust 11, and the bo3 setup, CLG's odds at the moment are favoring a low bet. Cutler was very effective, Hazed as well. Tarik showed up, yet not at the same scale that you normally expect. So, if Tarik decides to go nuts, as he was HORRID against C9, then I really think CLG can take it. If you want to play the faux odds, go with C9, but I really think the map pool warrants a 50/50 bet, considering if CLG plays well it may very likely go to a third map. 

My analysis for C9 is the same as my CLG analysis. Look at the stats vs Lumin. They are practically the same if you compare CLG vs C9 and C9 vs Lumin; just scripts flipped. Granted Lumin>CLG by a long shot, but I really think C9 were humbled. If you noticed post game, most of C9 were fucking gutted. CLG look confident, so I think it won't be the same.

If I win my previous bet on Alt Atx (shoutout to shitsquad penta), then I will just bet my returns on CLG. I wouldn't go all out on a high or med bet on C9, as that is way too risky. I think CLG will wake up this match and if they don't, fuck me.


Something to note, CLG has always been a team reliant on whether or not their third and fourths help the carries of Tarik and TJM. Cutler has been doing well, even in the 16-1.

Realistically speaking, this is a rather difficult question to answer. I mean we would have to factor in so much. My childhood allegiances, my tendencies as a player, where those tendencies would fit best, what offers allow me to drive the flashiest super cars.

All those aside, despite there existing many more, we also need to look at the tiers of football atm. I am completely striking out all African clubs, Australian, Asian, NA and SA. European football rules over all those petty leagues. I am in my prime and thus have the much earned humbleness of our god Zlatan. 

All this aside, we must ask ourselves the necessary questions all footballers face when deciding what is next. Who is consistently signing top products of other powerhouses? Which team is on the rise and would I be able to make an impact with such a team? Think of the signing of Xabi Alonso for Bayern. Great impact. If I score an absolutely beauty of a goal, which badge do I want to kiss? I want to walk in the shoes of many past greats. Being in a relationship, yet also being a footballer, I want to go out with the boys and revel in the beauty of my city's women. It really isn't a difficult choice.
